name: Savannah Cat Rescue
primary_job: First job: connect litters / unfixed moms to the TNR trap network.
description: Savannah-local collection whose pilot priority is matching neighbors who find stray litters or unfixed cats with the TNR / trap-and-release network. Capture the need, draft a human-sent Nextdoor reply, and ping craft IRC (#ga-savannah-cat-rescue) so trappers can coordinate — both paths, side by side. Humans always send on the origin network.

sync.goal: Visit every member group regularly; capture updates; draft human-sent replies; post updates back when useful
sync.cadence: human + MyProblem X session; batch organizes

notes: Collection owns the group roster — no post catalogs. Tip home stays georgia. Craft IRC encodes repo (ga) + collection slug.
